item.text:
Added a `createPost` Server Action in [app/actions.ts](/workspace/app/actions.ts:6). It saves the post, then calls `updateTag('posts')` after the write completes. That immediately expires the tagged cache so the next page load waits for fresh posts instead of serving stale content.

The posts query and form are wired up in [lib/posts.ts](/workspace/lib/posts.ts:19) and [app/page.tsx](/workspace/app/page.tsx:11). The production build passed, and a form submission was followed by a cache miss that showed the new post on the next load.

The starter has no database, so posts currently use a local JSON file. A deployed, multi-instance app would need a shared writable store.
